profile.headline: Software Engineer/DevOps at L3Harris
profile.summary:
I am an Information Systems major who wants to join a well respected company that will hopefully be the start of my career. I am ready to start a new chapter in my life. I am fluent in Spanish and very easy to work with.

Specialties: I have experience in web development and have worked in groups doing large projects. Also have worked with database systems using mySQL.
